name: Build Data Transformation Diagram
command:
Analyze the classes/codebase identified by "${source}". If "${source}" equals "all", detect and analyze every class in the project.

Preserve the Domain Language found in the code VERBATIM. Do not translate, rename, normalize, or anglicize any domain term. Render every class, table, field, API, and topic under its exact Domain-language name as written in source.

# Deliverables

## 1. Inventory (ASCII)
List, in ASCII:
- Classes          — Domain name + file path
- Database tables  — entity / table name
- REST / RPC APIs  — HTTP method + path
- Kafka / topics   — topic name (and partition key if declared)
- External systems — touched (DB, queue, API, file store)

## 2. Receive & Persist (Write-Side)
For each entry point that receives inbound data, draw an ASCII arrow chain:
  source -> API/class -> transformation -> table/topic -> persistence target
For each chain list:
- Mappings   — field -> column / field -> message-key
- Lookups     — joins, reference data, foreign keys
- Grouping   — aggregation keys, batch boundaries
- Enrichment, normalization, validation rules applied

## 3. Read & Use (Read-Side)
For every consumer of persisted data, name the place explicitly:
  read location (Class.method) -> query/read path -> downstream usage
Locate every read access with a named call site. Do not leave any read un-located.

## 4. Cross-Cutting Transformation Diagram (ASCII)
Join write-side and read-side end-to-end. Render all class / table / API / topic names in Domain language. Annotate every transformation step with its mappings, lookups, and grouping.

## 5. Transformation Smells
Flag each occurrence of: dual writes, missing idempotency, lookup N+1, unbounded reads, implicit grouping, magic strings in place of Domain enums.
